mockTests.title: KCET Physics Speed Practice Test (Mechanics & Waves)
mockTests.subject: Physics
mockTests.description: Timed practice test with previous KCET pattern questions covering Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work Energy, and Wave Optics.

questions.question: A ball is projected with kinetic energy E at an angle of 45° to the horizontal. At the highest point of its trajectory, its kinetic energy will be:
questions.explanation: At the highest point, vertical velocity is zero and horizontal velocity is v_h = v cos(45°) = v / √2. Therefore, KE = 1/2 m (v/√2)² = 1/2 (1/2 m v²) = E / 2.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: In Young’s double slit experiment, if the distance between the slits is halved and the distance between the screen and slits is doubled, the fringe width becomes:
questions.explanation: Fringe width β = (λ D) / d. If d becomes d/2 and D becomes 2D, then β' = (λ × 2D) / (d/2) = 4 × (λ D / d) = 4β.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: The electric potential V at any point (x, y, z) is given by V = 3x² volt. The electric field at (2m, 0, 1m) is:
questions.explanation: E = - dV/dx i = - d/dx(3x²) i = -6x i. At x = 2, E = -12 i V/m.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: A transformer has 500 turns in primary and 1000 turns in secondary. If 220 V AC is applied to primary, output voltage is:
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question: The de-Broglie wavelength of an electron accelerated through a potential difference of 100 V is approximately:
questions.subject: Physics

mockTests.title: NEET Biology High-Yield Mock (Human Physiology & Genetics)
mockTests.subject: Biology
mockTests.description: Authentic NCERT line questions for NEET medical aspirants focusing on Cardiology, Endocrine glands, Mendelian genetics and DNA replication.

questions.question: Which of the following hormones is secreted by the corpus luteum to maintain the endometrium?
questions.explanation: Progesterone is secreted in large amounts by the corpus luteum for maintenance of the endometrium, which is necessary for implantation of the fertilized ovum.
questions.subject: Biology

questions.question: In a dihybrid cross of peas, the phenotypic ratio obtained in the F2 generation according to Mendel’s law of independent assortment is:
questions.explanation: The classic dihybrid phenotypic ratio of Round Yellow : Round Green : Wrinkled Yellow : Wrinkled Green is 9:3:3:1.
questions.subject: Biology

questions.question: The enzyme responsible for unwinding the DNA double helix during replication is:
questions.explanation: DNA Helicase unwinds the DNA double helix by breaking the hydrogen bonds between complementary base pairs, creating the replication fork.
questions.subject: Biology

questions.question: Which valve prevents the backflow of deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle into the right atrium?
questions.explanation: The Tricuspid valve guards the right atrioventricular aperture and prevents backflow of blood into the right atrium during ventricular systole.
questions.subject: Biology

questions.question: The primary site of respiratory gas exchange in human lungs is:
questions.explanation: Alveoli are thin-walled, highly vascularized sac-like structures where O2 and CO2 diffuse across the alveolar-capillary membrane.
questions.subject: Biology
